pages.text: $(bold)Valkyrien Skies$() makes any build you assemble into a physical ship. $(bold)Eureka$() is the simple way: build a hull, place a helm, right-click to assemble, steer with the helm.$(br2)Rivers and coasts are everywhere here. A barge moves more than ten wagons.
Place the helm on the deck and assemble. Floaters add buoyancy, ballast sinks, balloons lift. An engine burns fuel for speed; sails are free.
Floaters keep a heavy hull up; balloons make airships.

$(bold)Ships are Tier 2$(): the Naga hold the knowledge. The helm, floaters, balloons and engine need the Blueprint; a hull is just blocks.$(br2)$(bold)Pirates$() sail ships of their own and will board yours. Cannons on a deck are the answer (Tier 3).
